verdict.rationale: Wave confirms it is built on real double-entry accounting (wave-supp-double-entry) and offers general 'bookkeeping records' (wave-docs-7), implying an underlying ledger with debits/credits, but no evidence explicitly describes a manual journal entry feature, balancing UI, or memo/notes field for such entries. Missing for 10: explicit journal entry creation workflow, debit/credit balance validation, memo/notes field support, and any accountant-facing screenshots or docs of this specific feature.
